$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (sources-outbound-rate-limit-pacing). Merges a `pace` object onto `source`: calls per window held in a budget every worker shares (lib/Service/Call/SourcePacer.php), with how long a live gateway call and background work may wait for their turn (design D2, D3). Merges `pacedMs` (the time a call waited for its turn) and `retryAfter` (the seconds a refused call was told to wait) onto `call_log` (design D4). Does NOT edit lib/Settings/integriq_register.json.

pace.title: Pace
pace.description: Spread calls to this source over its window instead of spending the budget at once. Calls wait for their turn; a live gateway call waits at most a short time, then answers 429 with Retry-After

maxCalls.title: Calls
maxCalls.description: How many calls the source allows per window

perSeconds.title: Per seconds
perSeconds.description: The window in seconds, for example 60 for calls per minute

burst.title: Burst
burst.description: How many calls may go back to back before spacing starts

maxLiveWaitMs.title: Longest live wait (ms)
maxLiveWaitMs.description: How long a live gateway call may wait for its turn before it answers 429

maxBackgroundWaitSeconds.title: Longest background wait (s)
maxBackgroundWaitSeconds.description: How long a synchronization, job or flow may wait for one call; beyond it a synchronization stops and resumes on its next run

pacedMs.title: Paced (ms)
pacedMs.description: How long the call waited for its turn under the source's pace

retryAfter.title: Retry after (s)
retryAfter.description: For a call refused because its paced turn was too far away: the seconds until its turn
